field_scope: The formal numerical barrier uses positive real theta. The cited polynomial constructions and operational theorem treat arbitrary fields.
prior_repository_attribution: PROVENANCE.md and research/ai/2026-10-21-pass-packing/ already credit Pass's construction and discuss its scalar packing inequality. The present extension concerns AVZ26's full rectangular operational potential family.
attribution: Pass retains credit for both polynomial packings. Amanov, van den Berg and Zuiddam retain credit for the formal operational potential, its concavity and the rectangular barrier. The discrete-tail extension and homogeneous dimension comparison are owner-directed Codex derivations, written and unreviewed.
